title: API Gateway: emit v1 audit events for admin actions + normalize actor attribution
author: Amara Diallo
description: Summary: This PR instruments the API Gateway admin/control endpoints to emit canonical Audit Log Schema v1 events for sensitive actions (quota overrides, rate-limit/quota policy updates, key validation / key-policy configuration changes), and standardizes actor attribution by deriving actor fields from auth context consistently. The goal is parity with Control Plane/Console audit events and to remove the current drift where some gateway-emitted events lack stable actor/source fields, which has shown up as inconsistent SIEM exports (ref SUP-18477). Context: As part of audit logging standardization (ENG-4824), we need 100% coverage for sensitive actions across the platform with consistent actor/target semantics and correlation IDs. Gateway is a key gap because it sits in front of several admin surfaces and also owns enforcement knobs (quota overrides, validation policies) that should be auditable. What changed: (1) Added Audit v1 emission to Gateway admin routes: POST/PUT /admin/quotas/overrides (create/update/delete override), PUT /admin/key-policy (allowed issuers, token validation flags, audience config), PUT /admin/rate-limits (tier config updates), and PUT /admin/quotas/defaults (tenant defaults). (2) Normalized actor attribution: implemented a single "ActorFromAuthContext" mapping used by all audit producers in gateway so actor_type/actor_id/actor_display_name/source_ip/user_agent/auth_method are consistently populated. Includes support for service-to-service calls (mTLS/JWT) and Console/admin UI calls (OIDC). (3) Correlation + idempotency: ensures request_id and trace_id are present on all emitted events; adds gateway_admin_action_id derived from request_id for internal correlation; event_id generated as ULID at emission time. (4) Cardinality and redaction: event payload includes bounded/summarized diffs (no raw policy JSON), and explicitly avoids emitting secrets/credentials. The only free-form strings are capped and allow-listed where applicable (e.g., quota_tier). (5) Tests: Added unit tests for actor mapping, diff summarization, and required-fields validation against schema v1; added integration test coverage for representative admin calls in gateway test harness. Event types introduced/used (registered in centralized registry already): - gateway.quota_override.created - gateway.quota_override.updated - gateway.quota_override.deleted - gateway.quota_defaults.updated - gateway.rate_limit_policy.updated - gateway.key_validation_policy.updated Example event (trimmed): {"schema_version":"1.0","event_id":"01JH8Y4J9K6R8E9P7YH5WQ8B9S","event_type":"gateway.quota_override.updated","occurred_at":"2026-02-01T19:22:11.481Z","environment":"prod","deployment_mode":"hosted","tenant_id":"tnt_9b7...","project_id":"prj_4a1...","actor_type":"user","actor_id":"usr_2c1...","actor_display_name":"chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com","auth_method":"oidc","source_ip":"203.0.113.10","user_agent":"Mozilla/5.0 ...","request_id":"req_7f6...","trace_id":"5d2c...","target_type":"tenant","target_id":"tnt_9b7...","resource_type":"quota_override","resource_id":"qov_13f...","action":"update","result":"success","changes_summary":"max_rps: 200 -> 500; expires_at: null -> 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"} Notes on behavior/failure modes: Audit emission is best-effort and must not break the admin workflow if the audit sink is degraded; we still log structured gateway errors and increment audit_emit_failed counter. (Delivery guarantees tracked in separate ADR/ENG-4829; this PR only aligns gateway with the platform standard.) Rollout/compatibility: This only adds new v1 events; does not remove legacy gateway logs. Exporter normalization is handled in audit-log-exporter (ENG-4827). Checklist: - [x] Event payloads validate against schema v1 - [x] Actor/source fields populated for user + service actors - [x] request_id + trace_id present - [x] No secrets/PII beyond policy-approved fields - [x] Tests added (unit + integration) - [x] Updated gateway admin endpoint docs (internal) Links: ENG-4824 (Gateway coverage), ENG-4830 (correlation IDs), PR #21984 (schema lib/validator), PR #21991 (event type registry)

conversation: Allison Grant (review): Can we ensure source_ip is pulled from the same trusted header set we use for request logging? Also please confirm we cap user_agent length to avoid cardinality / ingestion issues.

Amara Diallo (author): Yep. Switched to the existing "clientIpFromTrustedProxyChain" helper (same as access logs) and added a 256-char cap + "<truncated>" suffix for user_agent. Added a unit test for both.

Kevin Osei (review): For SIEM export dedupe, we should be explicit that event_id is stable per emission, but retries may cause duplicates. Do we include any idempotency key (e.g., request_id + event_type)?

Amara Diallo (author): Added gateway_admin_action_id = request_id and ensured request_id is always present. Export guidance will recommend de-dupe on (event_type, request_id) when present. event_id remains ULID per emission (consistent with platform direction in eng-security thread).
Ethan Park (review): Changes_summary should avoid embedding raw JSON blobs. For key_policy updates, can we summarize only the changed fields and keep allow-lists?

Amara Diallo (author): Updated diff builder to allow-list: issuers_count, audiences_count, "jwks_refresh_enabled" boolean, and "token_leeway_seconds". No raw issuer URLs or audience strings are logged (counts only). Added tests.
Sahana Iyer (review): CI lint is passing but can we add a compile-time check that every admin handler uses the AuditAdminAction wrapper? Otherwise future endpoints may skip emission.

Amara Diallo (author): Added a shared wrapper and refactored all admin handlers in this PR to use it. Follow-up ticket is in ENG-4831 for cross-service enforcement; within gateway I added an eslint rule scoped to /admin routes to prevent direct handler exports without wrapper (see last commit).

Marcus Lin (review): Looks good. Please confirm behavior when audit sink is down: admin action still succeeds but metrics and structured logs are emitted. Also add a short note in release notes for internal rollout.
Amara Diallo (author): Confirmed: emitter failure increments audit_emit_failed and logs a structured error with request_id/trace_id; no exception bubbles to handler. Added internal release note line.
release_notes: Internal: API Gateway now emits canonical audit events for quota overrides and key/rate-limit policy changes with normalized actor attribution (v1 schema).
notes: Post-merge: coordinate with Logan Wright/Nadia Rahman to ensure coverage dashboard picks up new gateway event types; verify sampling in prod once enabled for enterprise tenants.
